description: This Java test class contains unit tests for the PoliciesResourceType class in the Eclipse Ditto project. It verifies immutability, proper handling of null input, and correct resource key creation methods for policy, thing, and message resources.

classes.name: PoliciesResourceTypeTest
classes.description: Unit test class for PoliciesResourceType, testing immutability, null input handling, and resource key creation.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that the PoliciesResourceType class is immutable.

methods.name: tryToGetPolicyResourceWithNullResourcePath
methods.description: Ensures that calling policyResource() with null throws NullPointerException with the expected message.

methods.name: policyResourceReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that the policyResource() method returns the correct ResourceKey for a given path.

methods.name: thingResourceReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that the thingResource() method returns the correct ResourceKey for a given path.

methods.name: messageResourceReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that the messageResource() method returns the correct ResourceKey for a given path.

methods.name: createExpectedResourceKey
methods.description: Helper method to create expected ResourceKey objects for comparisons.
